summary: Custom DSC resources can be found on the PowerShell Gallery or with the Find-DscResource cmdlet, for example filtering by module name. Microsoft resources whose names start with x are experimental and unsupported.
questions: How do I find DSC resources for SQL Server?
Where can I find custom DSC resources?
What does the x prefix on DSC resource names mean?
Are xWebAdministration-style resources supported by Microsoft?

answer_card.title: Finding custom DSC resources
answer_card.answer_md:
Look on the PowerShell Gallery, or use `Find-DscResource`:

```powershell
# Find all DSC resources in the configured repositories
Find-DscResource

# Find all DSC resources that relate to SQL
Find-DscResource -ModuleName "*sql*"
```

Microsoft-developed resources whose names start with `x` are experimental and come with no support.
